display.purpose: Hero headlines, service names, and the contact address.

body.purpose: Chinese paragraphs, metadata, and descriptions beside expressive display type.

shadows.name: nav-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift the blue navigation pill over the paper field.

shadows.name: sticker-lift
shadows.purpose: Give the supplied artwork physical separation from the video/paper field.

motion.name: sticker-bob
motion.purpose: Slow ambient float for the hero artwork.

components.name: Contact Button
components.description: A compact paper pill that opens the contact path from the navigation.
components.css: .ds-contact { display:inline-flex; gap:.55rem; align-items:center; padding:.72rem 1.05rem; border-radius:999px; background:#f6f5f0; color:#143d84; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.06em; text-decoration:none; transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),background .25s; } .ds-contact:hover { background:#dfff38; transform:rotate(-3deg) scale(1.03); } .ds-contact:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #dfff38; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Skill Chip
components.description: An outlined informational tag used to list a design tool or practice.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-block; padding:.6rem .85rem; border:1px solid #143d84; border-radius:999px; color:#143d84; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.8rem; font-weight:700; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A blue pill-navigation link with an acid underline reveal.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position:relative; color:#f6f5f0; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:800; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-link::after { content:''; position:absolute; right:0; bottom:-.35rem; left:0; height:2px; background:#dfff38; transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:right; transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform:scaleX(1); transform-origin:left; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #dfff38; outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Project Poster
components.description: A square, linked poster field for a selected case study.
components.css: .ds-project { position:relative; display:block; min-height:220px; padding:1.2rem; overflow:hidden; background:#dfff38; color:#143d84; font-family:Arial,sans-serif; font-weight:900; text-decoration:none; transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-project strong { position:absolute; right:.04em; bottom:-.16em; font-size:5rem; line-height:.72; letter-spacing:-.08em; } .ds-project:hover { transform:translateY(-.65rem) rotate(1deg); } .ds-project:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #143d84; outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview: A cool-paper portfolio rebuilt directly from the supplied SVG template. Paper texture, pale SWL lettering, a central dimensional sticker, blue rails, and exact editorial placement keep the supplied composition ahead of interface chrome.

rules.name: The One-Signal Rule
rules.body: Lime only marks something actionable or moving; it does not become a general decoration.

rules.name: The Poster-Then-Reading Rule
rules.body: A section gets one dominant display statement; supporting text remains intentionally small and plain.

dos: Do keep the supplied blue-and-white artwork intact and in the visual lead.
Do use transforms and opacity for interactive movement and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't replace the hero with a generic grid of matching project cards.
Don't fabricate personal details, client histories, or project outcomes before they are supplied.
